meta.notes: Two sources, kept apart. The programme contacts (medical, family support, legal, housing, family advocacy, EFMP, child care, emergency relief) were imported by scripts/import-installations.mjs from the official MilitaryINSTALLATIONS pages for this installation. The agencies Military OneSource does not publish per installation were left empty — no official installation website was resolved for it, and Military OneSource itself is copied from national.json. Every contact carries the URL of the page it was read from; nothing here was typed in, inferred, or generated. Where both sources published a number the MilitaryINSTALLATIONS value stands and the base site’s is recorded in that contact’s notes rather than discarded. Still empty here, because no source read published one: command-post, mental-health, chaplain, sarc, security-forces, mfrc, finance, legal, mpf, family-advocacy, childcare, emergency-relief, equal-opportunity. Re-run either importer to refresh; the diff is the change.

contacts.name: Medical Care
contacts.location: Building 1802- 1st Street Rota Naval Station Rota (CADIZ) Spain
contacts.notes: BEFORE ARRIVAL You and your family are required to undergo a medical screening upon receipt of our orders to transfer to an overseas location. The screening must be completed at your current MTF (Medical Treatment Facility). You can find additional information on this topic at mynavyhr.navy.mil. UPON ARRIVAL There is no on-base hospital or pharmacy, but the Medical Aid Station at Moron Air Base provides basic support to military members only.
